messages:
Sam (Customer): Hi — we've submitted PO #PO-89234 but the supplier invoice (INV-2027) still shows 20% VAT. We're EU-based and should be reverse-charge exempt. I uploaded our VAT certificate in the billing portal but it says VIES validation failed. Can you reissue a backdated VAT-exempt invoice so our AP can process payment? Attached PDF.
Lina (Support): Thanks Sam — sorry for the trouble. Can you paste the VAT ID here or confirm the uploaded file name? Also confirm your company country so I can triage with billing.
Marco (Billing): Looking at INV-2027 — system flagged VAT because VIES returned 'no match' for the supplied ID. VAT ID in the upload (masked): GB999***973. VIES can be flaky for some member states. If you have a national VAT registration certificate or a resale certificate we can accept that as alternative evidence. Please either re-upload in Billing > Documents or email billing@redwood.com with the file and PO.
Sam (Customer): I tried again, file name was 'redwood_exemption_cert.pdf' — the portal showed 'upload failed'. I'll email it to billing now.
invoice-bot: File received: 'redwood_exemption_cert.pdf' (92KB) -> queued for manual review by AcctOps.
Jules (AcctOps): @Marco assigning this. Once we verify the cert we can issue a credit note and reissue an invoice without VAT under reverse charge. We will need: 1) copy of the VAT cert, 2) confirmation of the PO number, and 3) company registered address. Also note — accounting requires a written request for backdating (ticket or email) to process a prior-period invoice.
Marco (Billing): Procedural summary for the team and customer:
```
1) AcctOps verifies document authenticity.
2) Create credit note for INV-2027.
3) Reissue invoice as INV-2027-RC with reverse-charge notation (net amount, 0% VAT, reference to PO#).
```
Expect 3–5 business days after verification. If the customer needs immediate AP evidence we can issue a provisional statement of intent while reissue is processed.
Sam (Customer): Thanks. PO is PO-89234. Company address: 1 High St, Dublin, IE. I just emailed billing with the attachment. Any chance to expedite? AP is holding payment until invoice matches PO.
Lina (Support): I'll mark this as priority and add :eyes: to AcctOps. Jules — can you confirm target SLA for manual verification?
Jules (AcctOps): We'll start verification today; target is <48 hours. If VIES intermittently fails we accept either: a) national VAT registration PDF, b) a VIES response screenshot plus a signed cover note from company finance. Once verified we'll update the thread and Marco will reissue.
Sam (Customer): Appreciate it, thank you :thumbsup:
Marco (Billing): Noted. Internal ticket created: BI-5591. I'll update here once the credit note and reissued invoice are posted.
Lina (Support): Closing loop from support side — will follow up when INV-2027-RC is issued. Sam, if you keep seeing upload errors please send attachments to billing@redwood.com and include 'BI-5591' in the subject to speed routing.
Sam (Customer): Done — email sent with attachment and BI-5591 in subject. Awaiting confirmation.
Jules (AcctOps): Received docs from billing@redwood.com. Starting verification now.
Sam (Customer): thanks!"
